text: {"rules":[{"jurisdiction":"Santa Ana, CA","level":"city","category":"rent_increase_limits","status":"in_force","title":"Santa Ana Rent Stabilization Ordinance","requirement":"Residential rent increases are limited to the lower of 3% per year or 80% of the percent change in the CPI over the most recent 12-month period. If the CPI is negative, no increase is permitted. The City publishes the allowable increase no later than June 30 each year, effective September 1. Owners may petition for relief from the cap by showing that a larger increase is necessary for a fair and reasonable return. The City Manager or designee decides within 60 days of a complete application.
